# DumpLedger MBT trace corpus

`traces/` is the positive compiler corpus. It is generated by MirrorECMA
`runClientGenTraces` over stdio, using the witness modules in `specs/mbt/` and
the current Mirrors binary. Each selected trace is an Apalache counterexample
to `WitnessNotReached`, so its final state is the named reachable outcome. The
six traces collectively exercise every declared initializer/action and all
three accepted coverage kinds.

`negative/` contains deliberate single-fault derivatives of the partial-dump
trace for compiler and generated-binding failure tests. They must never be
passed as part of the positive directory:

- `mismatched-types`: invalid `#meta.varTypes` evidence;
- `missing-observation`: omits `downloadable` at one state;
- `unknown-action`: uses an undeclared wire action;
- `wrong-kind-type`: projects an integer where `Kind` requires a string;
- `out-of-universe-slot`: remains structurally type-correct to the compiler,
  and is reserved for the client-local adapter's finite-slot validation.

The generated interface intentionally exposes model slots as `bigint`; it does
not treat the finite `1..2` model universe as a production identifier type.

`transfer-traces/` is the DumpLedgerTransfer corpus, generated by
`tools/generate-transfer-mbt-traces.ts` from the `specs/mbt/Transfer*.tla`
witness modules (round trip, tamper rejection, tombstones, fingerprint
mismatch, export failure, import hard failure, and an in-flight skip with a
dangling consumed grant). It is replayed by `test/mbt/transfer-lowlevel.test.ts`
through a handwritten MirrorECMA StateComputer — no generated interface is
involved — and collectively covers every transfer wire action.
